name: Skavio USDC Payment Verification & Proof MCP
tagline: USDC x402 proof tools plus authenticated web search, extraction and monitoring
description: Connect directly to Skavio hosted Streamable HTTP MCP, with 18 discoverable tools. x402 v2 paid functions verify native Circle USDC transfers across seven chains (0.02 USDC), match recipient/amount (0.03), generate blockchain evidence PDFs (0.05), and audit DNS/TLS (0.05), paid via x402 v2 in native Circle USDC on Base or Solana. The three standalone HTTP x402 routes remain Base-only. Three separate authenticated AgentTools web_fetch/web_extract/web_monitor relays now support Serper query and HTTPS URL sources, optionally DeepSeek analysis; those require your own Skavio company Bearer API key and a separate per-workload quote or prepaid credits. Installing this MCP does not provide wallet access or free execution. Evidence PDFs are not tax invoices. Documentation: https://github.com/skavio-eu/skavio-agent-tools/blob/main/guides/verify-usdc-with-x402.md

install.notes: Hosted public MCP discovery works without a wallet. To invoke paid tools, configure a separate client that supports x402 v2 settlement with native Circle USDC on Base or Solana; standalone HTTP x402 APIs remain Base-only; no wallet keys or signing data are requested by this listing.
